items.text: Add a Realistic Quality Add Add a Realistic Quality Add a realistic quality-of-life buffer. Health, learning, emergency margin, and a reasonable lifestyle matter. Do not plan only for bare survival.

items.heading: Start with Current Monthly Essentials
items.text: Start with current monthly essentials. Include rent, food, transport, bills, insurance, education costs, and debt.
